**Proposed mechanism:** PAX3 (HGNC:8604) —DISRUPTS→ Skeletal muscle development and differentiation (GO:0048700); PAX7 (HGNC:8606) —DISRUPTS→ Skeletal muscle development and differentiation (GO:0048700); FOXO1 (HGNC:4090) —DISRUPTS→ Skeletal muscle development and differentiation (GO:0048700); Skeletal muscle development and differentiation (GO:0048700) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental abnormality (HP:0001263); Chromosomal translocation t(2;13)(q35;q14) (NCIT:C36741) —PRODUCES→ PAX3-FOXO1 fusion protein (HGNC:28700); Chromosomal translocation t(1;13)(p36;q14) (NCIT:C36740) —PRODUCES→ PAX7-FOXO1 fusion protein (HGNC:28701); PAX3-FOXO1 fusion protein (HGNC:28700) —LEADS_TO→ Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (MONDO:0009994); PAX7-FOXO1 fusion protein (HGNC:28701) —LEADS_TO→ Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (MONDO:0009994). Haploinsufficiency in genes like PAX3, PAX7, or FOXO1 can disrupt the intricate processes of skeletal muscle development, leading to Disease A. Conversely, specific chromosomal translocations involving PAX3 or PAX7 with FOXO1 create fusion proteins (PAX3-FOXO1 or PAX7-FOXO1) that aberrantly regulate gene expression, driving the oncogenesis of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (Disease B).

**How to falsify it:** If pathogenic variants in PAX3, PAX7, or FOXO1 are not found to segregate with Disease A, or if the specific chromosomal translocations leading to PAX3-FOXO1 or PAX7-FOXO1 fusion proteins are absent in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma cases, this hypothesis would be falsified. Furthermore, if Disease A is found to be caused by mutations in genes entirely unrelated to muscle development pathways, the link would be weakened.

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic underpinnings and divergent functional consequences of PAX3, PAX7, and FOXO1 in these diseases could inform targeted therapeutic strategies. For Disease A, therapies aimed at compensating for haploinsufficiency might be explored. For alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, targeting the aberrant fusion proteins or downstream pathways they activate represents a key therapeutic avenue.
